booking_calendars.description: Calendars (a host's booking page): list, create, update and delete, add, clone and order their event types, and the sharing and landing page settings.

booking_events.description: Event types (what people book): read, patch and delete, details, limits, host assignments, advanced and recurring settings, booking form fields, and per-event availability and open slots.
booking_events.note: Assignments, advanced and recurring settings, available slots and the Pro availability options need FluentBooking Pro.

booking_notifications.description: Per-event automations: email and SMS notifications, webhook feeds, and integration feeds (FluentCRM and other connected apps), including copying them from another event type.
booking_notifications.note: SMS notifications and webhooks need FluentBooking Pro.

booking_meetings.description: Booked meetings: list, search and export, read, patch and delete, create and reschedule a booking, open slots, notes, activity, group attendees, confirmation emails, and the attendee's FluentCRM contact, tags and lists.

booking_availability.description: Availability schedules (working hours): list, create, update, rename, clone, make default and delete, and see which event types use them.

booking_integrations.description: Connected services: global integrations, per-host integration settings, Zoom accounts, and each calendar's remote calendars (Google, Outlook, CalDAV), conflict checking and Zoom connection.
booking_integrations.note: Per-host settings, Zoom and calendar integrations need FluentBooking Pro.

booking_payments.description: Paid bookings: an event type's payment settings, payment methods and their connection, currencies, WooCommerce products, and a booking's payment transaction.
booking_payments.note: Everything except reading an event type's payment settings needs FluentBooking Pro.

booking_settings.description: Global settings: general, payment and theme settings, feature modules, add-ons, team members and hosts, spam protection, the Pro license, and the site-side MCP adapter.
booking_settings.note: Team, spam protection and license settings need FluentBooking Pro.

booking_reports.description: Read-only reporting: booking totals for a period, graph data, and the latest booking activity.

settings/install-plugin.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: installs plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/install-mcp-adapter.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: installs plugin code on the site. Requires confirm:true.

settings/save-mcp-settings.bodyNote: Privilege/code change: changes the site-side MCP adapter (a second AI control surface). Requires confirm:true.

settings/update-team-member.bodyNote: Privilege change: grants or changes a WordPress user's FluentBooking permissions. Requires confirm:true.

payments/update-booking-transaction.bodyNote: Changes a booking's payment record. Requires confirm:true.

schedules/send-confirmation-email.bodyNote: Emails the attendee (a real person). Requires confirm:true.
